scenarios.reasoning: Strong, well-evidenced identification of the dominant root cause (net472 leg lacking System.Runtime.Loader/AssemblyLoadContext) and an excellent explanation of the FS0072 cascade. But it missed MetadataUpdater and, more significantly, incorrectly declared the net10.0 leg clean, misattributing the genuinely separate FS0001/FS0193 type errors to net472 overload differences — an incorrect conclusion that would misdirect the fix.
scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that FS0039 errors occur ONLY on net472
Identified undefined symbols as .NET-only APIs (MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader)
Explained net472 lacks these APIs causing FS0039
Noted net10.0 FS0001 errors as a separate real problem
